headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: Two ministries: By 2030, the proportion of capacity at large modern coal mines nationwide to rise to 87%
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development.' It states that by 2030, coal's role as a safety net will be further strengthened, production and development layout continuously optimized, the share of quality advanced capacity further increased, and the production-supply-storage-sales system more complete, with the share of large modern coal mines rising to 87%. Safe green development and clean efficient utilization levels will improve markedly, with full-system intelligent construction advanced and the share of intelligent coal mine capacity rising to 75%. A coal-based diversified industrial pattern will take shape faster, coal consumption will peak, the dynamic supply-demand balance guarantee mechanism will be further improved, industry modernization governance capacity notably enhanced, a modern coal industry system basically established, and high-quality coal development taken to a new level.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场 完善基础制度和规则
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，持续推进现代煤炭市场建设，积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场，完善基础制度和规则，健全信息共享机制，进一步发挥全国煤炭交易中心作用。完善电煤保供中长期合同制度，推进煤炭交易合同规范化标准化，加强合同签约履约监管。健全煤炭市场价格形成机制，结合市场形势和成本变化适时完善煤炭价格区间调控政策，规范价格指数行为。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Actively develop a unified national coal trading market, improve foundational systems and rules
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which calls for continuing to build a modern coal market, actively developing a unified national coal trading market, improving foundational systems and rules, strengthening information-sharing mechanisms, and further leveraging the role of the national coal trading center. It also calls for improving the medium- and long-term contract system for coal power supply assurance, promoting standardized coal trading contracts, and strengthening supervision of contract signing and performance. The plan aims to improve the coal market price formation mechanism, timely refine coal price range regulation policies based on market conditions and cost changes, and regulate price index behavior.

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: By 2030, coal's role as a safety net for supply will be further strengthened
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which states the plan adheres to the principles of bottom-line thinking and safety as the foundation, clean efficiency and green low-carbon, innovation-driven industrial upgrading, market orientation and efficiency enhancement, and people's livelihood priority with integrated development. By 2030, coal's safety net guarantee capacity will be further strengthened, production and development layout continuously optimized, the share of quality advanced capacity further increased, and the production-supply-storage-sales system more complete, with the share of large modern coal mines rising to 87%. Safe green development and clean efficient utilization levels will improve markedly, full-system intelligent construction will be advanced, and the share of intelligent coal mine capacity will rise to 75%. A coal-based diversified industrial pattern will take shape faster, coal consumption will peak, the dynamic supply-demand balance guarantee mechanism will be further improved, industry modernization governance capacity notably enhanced, and a modern coal industry system basically established.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: Shanghai Composite Index rises 0.67% for fifth straight gain; pharmaceuticals and consumer stocks rally
headlines.summary_en: Markets oscillated divergently all day, with the three major indexes mixed. Consumer stocks like food gained, with Huangshi Group, Xiangpiaopiao, and Yiming Food hitting limit-up. Pharmaceutical stocks extended gains, with Baihua Pharmaceutical up five consecutive limit-ups, and Asia-Pacific Pharmaceutical, Hayao, and others hitting limit-up. Gold stocks rose and fluctuated, with Zhaojin Gold, Chaohongji, and Mankalong hitting limit-up. Defense sector was active, with Hongdu Aviation, Hunan Tianyan, and Great Wall Military hitting limit-up. On the downside, computing hardware stocks like PCB and CPO fell, with Taijin New Energy down over 8%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets in the green, and turnover near 2.54 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.67%, the Shenzhen Component rose 0.04%, and the ChiNext fell 0.73%.

headlines.title: 上海：推动算力和基础大模型扩大境外调用，支持智能体、多模态生成等模型产品出口
headlines.summary: 上海市商务委等七部门印发《上海市国家服务贸易创新发展示范区建设方案》。其中指出，吸引企业和机构设立人工智能研发中心、开源平台和合作实验室。推动算力和基础大模型扩大境外调用，支持智能体、多模态生成等模型产品出口。推动具身智能等智能终端企业拓展全周期服务新模式。支持人工智能赋能医疗、教育、专业服务等行业。办好世界人工智能大会和全球开发者活动，加快世界人工智能合作组织总部建设。支持浦东新区建设人工智能创新应用先导区，支持徐汇区建设“模速空间”大模型创新生态社区。探索建立人工智能全球治理体系。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Promote expanded overseas invocation of computing power and foundational large models, support exports of model products such as agents and multimodal generation
headlines.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Commerce Commission and six other departments issued the 'Shanghai National Service Trade Innovation Development Demonstration Zone Construction Plan.' It calls for attracting companies and institutions to set up AI R&D centers, open-source platforms, and collaborative laboratories. It aims to promote overseas calls of computing power and foundational large models, and support exports of model products like agents and multimodal generation. It also supports embodied intelligence and other intelligent terminal companies in expanding full-cycle service models. AI empowerment for industries such as healthcare, education, and professional services is supported. The plan includes hosting the World Artificial Intelligence Conference and global developer events, and accelerating the construction of the World AI Cooperation Organization headquarters. It supports Pudong New Area in building an AI innovation application pilot zone and Xuhui District in building the 'Model Space' large-model innovation ecosystem community. It also explores establishing a global AI governance system.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：加强负面清单管理，原则上停止新建、改扩建不符合条件煤矿
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，加强负面清单管理，原则上停止新建、改扩建以下煤矿：山西、内蒙古、陕西、新疆（除南疆外）产能低于120万吨/年的煤矿，宁夏产能低于60万吨/年的煤矿，其他地区产能低于30万吨/年的煤矿。停止新建产能低于90万吨/年的煤与瓦斯突出、冲击地压、水文地质类型极复杂的煤矿。停止新建第一水平开采深度超1000米和改扩建开采深度超1200米的煤矿，停止新建和改扩建开采深度超过600米的小型煤矿。禁止在生态保护红线、自然保护地、饮用水水源保护区等生态敏感区内规划新建煤矿。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Strengthen negative list management; in principle, stop construction of new and renovation/expansion of non-compliant coal mines
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which states that negative list management will be strengthened, with new construction or renovation of the following coal mines generally stopped: mines in Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, and Xinjiang (excluding southern Xinjiang) with capacity below 1.2 million tons/year, mines in Ningxia with capacity below 600,000 tons/year, and mines in other regions with capacity below 300,000 tons/year. New construction of coal and gas outburst, rock burst, or extremely complex hydrogeological mines with capacity below 900,000 tons/year will be stopped. New mines with first-level mining depth exceeding 1,000 meters and renovation projects with depth exceeding 1,200 meters will be stopped, as will new construction and renovation of small mines exceeding 600 meters in depth. New coal mines will be prohibited in ecological red lines, nature reserves, drinking water source protection zones, and other ecologically sensitive areas.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：积极推进煤炭法修订 完善煤炭行业标准（MT）体系
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，积极推进煤炭法修订，完善煤炭行业标准（MT）体系。强化 煤炭矿区总体规划管理，严格落实矿区总体规划确定的开发方案， 提高资源集约高效开发水平。加强产能“一本账”管理，适时调整 完善产能置换政策，强化产能登记公告管理，促进建设生产平稳有 序。强化煤矿关闭退出计划管理，引导企业平稳转型，稳妥做好人 员安置、债务处置、生态修复等工作。健全煤炭产供储销统计体系， 强化能源、安监、税务等部门信息共享和协同监管，加强煤炭生产 监督管理，严厉打击煤矿超产行为，规范煤炭市场秩序。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Actively advance revision of the Coal Law, improve the coal industry standard (MT) system
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which calls for actively advancing the revision of the Coal Law and improving the coal industry standard (MT) system. It strengthens overall planning management of coal mining areas, strictly implements development plans determined by mining area master plans, and improves intensive and efficient resource development. It also strengthens 'one ledger' capacity management, timely adjusts and improves capacity replacement policies, strengthens capacity registration announcement management, and promotes smooth and orderly construction and production. The plan strengthens management of coal mine closure and exit plans, guides enterprises in smooth transition, and properly handles personnel placement, debt disposal, and ecological restoration. It also improves the coal production-supply-storage-sales statistical system, strengthens information sharing and coordinated supervision among energy, safety supervision, and tax departments, intensifies coal production supervision, severely cracks down on mine overproduction, and regulates coal market order.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：深入实施“人工智能+”行动 加强煤炭领域人工智能数据归集
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，加快人工智能场景化应用，深入实施“人工智能+”行动，加强煤炭领域人工智能数据归集，推进人工智能在勘探设计、建设生产、运营维护、安全管理等重点场景系统化应用。加快研发推广煤炭领域专用大模型，重点突破智能感知、自主决策、智能控制等关键技术瓶颈，培育建设一批人工智能融合应用试点煤矿，促进煤矿安全生产水平提高。大力实施灾害严重矿井、发生较大及以上事故矿井智能化改造，推动危险繁重岗位机器人作业替代。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Deeply implement the 'Artificial Intelligence+' initiative, strengthen data aggregation for AI in the coal sector
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which calls for accelerating AI scenario applications, deeply implementing the 'AI+' action, strengthening AI data collection in the coal sector, and promoting systematic AI applications in key scenarios such as exploration and design, construction and production, operation and maintenance, and safety management. It aims to accelerate R&D and promotion of coal-specific large models, focus on breakthroughs in key technologies like intelligent perception, autonomous decision-making, and intelligent control, and cultivate a batch of AI application pilot coal mines to improve coal mine safety production. It also calls for implementing intelligent transformation of mines with severe disasters or major accidents, and promoting robot substitution in dangerous and labor-intensive positions.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：优化煤炭生产组织 有序释放先进产能
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，持续加强煤炭稳产稳供，优化煤炭生产组织，科学安排采掘接续，有序释放先进产能。研究建立重点产煤省区协同生产机制，推动市场平稳运行。加强供需监测和生产调度，强化电煤保供中长期合同签订履约，高效开展区域互济、多能互补，提升迎峰度夏、迎峰度冬等重点时段顶峰保供能力。稳定“两湖一江”、东北、西南等重点地区煤炭供应，深化煤炭调入区与主产区供需衔接和战略合作，优化储煤基地建设布局，提高电厂存煤水平，突出保障民生用煤需求。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Optimize coal production organization, orderly release advanced capacity
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which calls for continuing to strengthen stable coal production and supply, optimizing coal production organization, scientifically arranging mining and excavation succession, and orderly releasing advanced capacity. It studies establishing a coordinated production mechanism for key coal-producing provinces and regions to promote smooth market operations. It strengthens supply-demand monitoring and production scheduling, enhances medium- and long-term contract signing and performance for coal power supply assurance, efficiently carries out regional mutual support and multi-energy complementarity, and improves peak supply capacity for summer and winter demand peaks. It stabilizes coal supply in key regions like 'Two Lakes, One River' (Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi), Northeast, and Southwest, deepens supply-demand linkage and strategic cooperation between coal-importing regions and major producing areas, optimizes storage base layout, raises power plant coal inventory levels, and highlights guarantees for residential coal demand.

headlines.title: 两部门：持续推进现代煤炭市场建设
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场，完善基础制度和规则，健全信息共享机制，进一步发挥全国煤炭交易中心作用。完善电煤保供中长期合同制度，推进煤炭交易合同规范化标准化，加强合同签约履约监管。健全煤炭市场价格形成机制，结合市场形势和成本变化适时完善煤炭价格区间调控政策，规范价格指数行为。

headlines.title_en: Two ministries: Continue advancing the construction of a modern coal market
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which mentions actively developing a unified national coal trading market, improving foundational systems and rules, strengthening information-sharing mechanisms, and further leveraging the role of the national coal trading center. It also calls for improving the medium- and long-term contract system for coal power supply assurance, promoting standardized and normalized coal trading contracts, and strengthening supervision of contract signing and performance. The plan aims to improve the coal market price formation mechanism, timely refine coal price range regulation policies based on market conditions and cost changes, and regulate price index behavior.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：各类型煤矿新增产能要严格执行产能置换政策
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，有序推进接续产能建设，持续推进煤炭资源勘查，强化资源综合评价，提升资源储量规模，保障煤炭接续开发。加强产能总量调控，统筹资源开发潜力、区域供需平衡等因素，合理安排接续产能规模，重点布局在五大供应保障基地内，优先支持上下游一体化产业发展和跨区域煤炭供应保障项目。“十五五”期间，新增产能必须纳入产能“一本账”后组织实施。各类型煤矿新增产能要严格执行产能置换政策

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: New capacity at all types of coal mines must strictly implement capacity replacement policies
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Coal Industry Development,' which states that succession capacity construction will be orderly advanced, with continued coal resource exploration, strengthened comprehensive resource evaluation, and enhanced resource reserve scale to ensure continued coal development. Total capacity will be controlled, with succession capacity scale reasonably arranged considering factors like resource development potential and regional supply-demand balance, mainly deployed within five major supply guarantee bases, prioritizing support for upstream-downstream integrated industrial development and cross-regional coal supply assurance projects. During the '15th Five-Year Plan' period, new capacity must be included in the 'one ledger' before implementation. All types of coal mines must strictly implement capacity replacement policies for new capacity.

headlines.title: 澳大利亚延期发布对进口自中国的二氧化钛反倾销基本事实报告和终裁
headlines.summary: 8月7日，澳大利亚反倾销委员会发布第2026/101号公告称，延期发布对进口自中国的二氧化钛（Titanium Dioxide）反倾销调查基本事实报告和终裁。澳大利亚反倾销委员会预计将不晚于2027年4月6日完成本案调查的基本事实报告，不晚于2027年6月3日向澳大利亚工业、创新和科学部长提交终裁报告。2026年4月30日，澳大利亚反倾销委员会发布第2026/061号公告称，应澳大利亚国内企业Tronox Limited提交的申请，对进口自中国的二氧化钛启动反倾销调查。涉案产品的澳大利亚海关编码为3206.11.00.48。案件倾销调查期为2025年1月

headlines.title_en: Australia postpones release of basic facts report and final ruling on anti-dumping investigation into titanium dioxide imported from China
headlines.summary_en: On August 7, the Australian Anti-Dumping Commission issued Notice No. 2026/101, announcing a delay in releasing the essential facts report and final determination of its anti-dumping investigation into titanium dioxide imported from China. The Commission expects to complete the essential facts report for the case no later than April 6, 2027, and submit the final determination report to Australia's Minister for Industry, Innovation and Science no later than June 3, 2027. On April 30, 2026, the Commission issued Notice No. 2026/061, initiating the anti-dumping investigation into titanium dioxide from China following an application by Australian domestic company Tronox Limited. The Australian Customs tariff code for the subject goods is 3206.11.00.48. The investigation period for dumping is January 2025.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：持续优化“西煤东运”“北煤南运”运输体系
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，完善煤炭跨区调运格局，持续优化“西煤东运”“北煤南运”运输体系，提升煤炭跨区调运能力。东南沿海地区国内供应以山西、蒙西、陕北基地为主，通过大秦、朔黄、瓦日等通道运至北方港口下水调入，合理利用进口煤保障供应。“两湖一江”（湖北、湖南、江西）地区重点通过浩吉、焦柳等通道及铁水联运网络，从蒙西、陕北、山西基地调入。东北地区主要依托蒙东基地供应，少量从蒙西、山西基地调入。西南地区立足本区域供应，部分通过西康、兰渝等通道从陕北、蒙西基地调入，稳步提升从新疆基地调入比例。

headlines.title_en: National Development and Reform Commission and National Energy Administration: Continue optimizing the 'West-to-East Coal Transport' and 'North-to-South Coal Transport' systems
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration have issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Coal Industry Development.' It states that the cross-regional coal transportation pattern will be improved, with continued optimization of the 'West-to-East Coal Transport' and 'North-to-South Coal Transport' systems to enhance cross-regional coal shipping capacity. For the southeast coastal regions, domestic supply will primarily come from the Shanxi, Western Inner Mongolia, and Northern Shaanxi bases, shipped via corridors such as Daqin, Shuohuang, and Watang to northern ports for onward delivery, with imported coal used rationally to secure supply. For the 'Two Lakes and One River' region (Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi), supply will mainly come from the Western Inner Mongolia, Northern Shaanxi, and Shanxi bases via corridors such as Haoji and Jiaoliu, as well as rail-water intermodal networks. The northeast region will rely mainly on the Eastern Inner Mongolia base, with small amounts from the Western Inner Mongolia and Shanxi bases. The southwest region will rely on local supply, with partial inflows from the Northern Shaanxi and Western Inner Mongolia bases via corridors such as Xikang and Lanyu, while steadily increasing the proportion of supply from the Xinjiang base.
